'''Judith Lee MacKenzie Gersting''' (born August 20, 1940){{r|born}} is an American mathematician, computer scientist, and textbook author. She is a professor emerita of computer science at [[Indiana University–Purdue University Indianapolis]]{{r|iupui}} and at the [[University of Hawaiʻi at Hilo]].{{r|hilo}}

==Education and career==
Gersting graduated from [[Stetson University]] in 1962,{{r|green}} and completed a Ph.D. in mathematics in 1969 at [[Arizona State University]]. Her dissertation, ''Some Results on <math>t</math>-Regressive Isols'', concerned [[recursive function theory]] and was supervised by Matt Hassett.{{r|mg|wphd}}

After holding a faculty position in the department of mathematical sciences at Indiana University–Purdue University Indianapolis (IUPUI) for ten years, and becoming a full professor there, she spent a year at the [[University of Central Florida]] before returning to IUPUI in 1981 as professor of mathematics and acting chair of the department of computer and information science.{{r|green}} She came to the University of Hawaiʻi at Hilo in 1990,{{r|regents}} and chaired the computer science department there for many years. After retiring from the University of Hawaiʻi, she became a part-time faculty member at IUPUI.{{r|hilo}}

==Books==
Gersting's books include:
*''Abstract Algebra: A First Look'' (with Joseph E. Kuczkowski, [[Marcel Dekker]], 1977){{r|aa}}
*''The Metric System'' (with Elaine V. Alton, Cummings, 1977){{r|tms}}
*''Yes–No; Stop–Go: Some Patterns in Mathematical Logic'' (with Joseph E. Kuczkowski and Don Madden, Crowell, 1977){{r|ynsg}}
*''Mathematical Structures for Computer Science'' (W. H. Freeman, 1982; 7th ed., 2014){{r|mscs}}
*''Technical Calculus with Analytic Geometry'' (Wadsworth, 1984; Dover, 1992){{r|tcag}}
*''The Computer: History, Workings, Uses & Limitations'' (with Michael C. Gemignani, Ardsley House, 1988){{r|tc}}
*''The Programming Process with Pascal'' (West Publishing, 1989)
*''Invitation to Computer Science'' (with G. Michael Schneider, West Publishing, 1995; 8th ed., [[Cengage]], 2018)
*''Visual Basic Programming: A Laboratory Approach'' (Computer Science Press, 1996)

With Henry M. Walker, she was co-chair and co-editor of the annual symposium on computer science education of [[SIGCSE]] in 2002.{{r|sigcse}}

==Recognition==
The University of Hawaii system awarded Gersting the Regents’ Excellence in Teaching Award in 2006.{{r|regents}}
